model: gpt-6.1-terra via signed-in local Codex CLI

methods.selection: Two published panels, 28 different original and hashed Perception Test films. For each frozen pair of answer choices, find the longest separately annotated interval for the alternate class and the longest interval in the original event not overlapping that alternate. Use the central portion of each at the same native sample length, from 200 ms to 4 seconds. Excluded four ineligible films before reading. Other sound classes can coexist with the annotated events. No new people rated these altered movies.
methods.movies: Use the moving pictures of the selected original interval for all three arms. Sound is original, a different equal-length annotated event from the same film, or exact digital silence. Keep original levels, rate and channels. Verify the same decoded video frame/PTS digest and the native audio hashes. Trim on replay at the reported sample boundary for every arm.
methods.gpt: One new ephemeral text/image session per arm, no filename, no key, no prior answers. Watch all released media with view, then ask_scene on the exact whole interval with alternatives. Only the comparison and visual tools are available; GPT receives the images, acoustic measurements and local sound estimates, without a native WAV or the 30B optional reader. One answer A, B or ? when unresolved. Digital silence is scored separately from the source cases.
methods.compact: Separate audio-only diagnostic using Gemma 4 E2B IT, MLX 4-bit checkpoint 238767527555cb75a05732a84dff5d6ba0dd6809. At the first answer token take the highest log probability among A, B, ?. Average log probabilities over distinct recorded channels. Repeat with the descriptions in reverse order, then map the letters back. These are constrained predictions of a different model. The GPT sessions never received them.
methods.clap: Raw CLAP embeddings computed from each released waveform played once with zero padding, averaged across active channels. Independent picks the higher cosine on each recording. Forced one each picks the assignment with the larger sum, assuming both labels occur exactly once. This assumption is true by construction for the distinct pairs only, and is not a general decision rule.
methods.picture_digest: SHA-256 of FFmpeg framemd5 output with the software-version header removed, lines joined with LF and no trailing LF. Covers decoded frame hashes and timestamps.
